builder.title: Build the viewer
builder.text: Build a Flask + HTML app on port 8837 from job-postings-50.csv. Parse multiline CSV correctly. Add a searchable list with counted filters and sorting. Open a row in three columns: job requirements | job posting | Good/Bad + notes. Add Skip, Save & next and previous notes (Nr | Text), refreshed on Next. No Advanced section. Save reviews with sample_id, posting_version, posting_sha256, verdict, note, timestamp and manual_review. Keep history; export JSON. Escape source text. Make it mobile friendly.

taxonomy.title: Group the review notes
taxonomy.output: Error types with boundaries and examples

judge.title: Build one LLM judge

evals.title: Create the eval script
evals.text: Write a Python eval script using the CSV, latest human reviews per posting hash, and judge-prompt.txt. Judge one error type per call; use a configured model API, cache by input/prompt/version, and enforce an explicit cost cap. Never send keys to the browser. Require human per-error labels; an overall Bad is not a label for every error. Validate pass/fail + reason JSON; report invalid responses separately. Failure is positive. Return TP/FP/FN/TN, accuracy, precision, recall, TNR and counts by split and error. Show evidence for disagreements. Train examples only in prompt; tune on dev; freeze before test. Do not claim measured results without calls.

synthetic.title: Generate synthetic inputs
synthetic.output: New requirement cases, then reviewed postings
synthetic.text: Generate 20 fictional job-requirement cases. Feature: write a public job posting. Job types: engineer, designer, support specialist, operations coordinator. Scenarios: optional skill, part-time hours, fixed-term contract, hybrid work, salary not approved, relocation support unknown. Vary combinations; do not change the single feature. Return sample_id, family_id, job_title, job_requirements and expected behavior. Include normal and difficult cases. Group related variants into one split. Do not generate gold labels from the writer; have a domain expert review each produced posting.
